answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the pulse graph. Re-attestations are stored in sparrow and saffron lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 11 epochs, so holding a position needs ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 526 impostors cost 281 times the honest price and take 25 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
